title: Your coaching. <piv>In their pocket.</piv>
lead: You build the experience. They follow it — in a focused mobile app with five tabs and nothing they don't need.

today.title: What to do today, at a glance.
today.body: Workout, meals, cardio and check-in — one ring, one list, one tap to start.

train.title: You program it. They perform it.
train.body: Video and cues for every exercise, last session's numbers, and set-by-set weight and rep logging. Forma keeps the history together.

fuel.title: Macros without the guesswork.
fuel.body: The meals you planned, macros remaining, and only the swaps you approved.

progress.title: Proof they're moving.
progress.body: Weight trend, measurements, photos and personal records — the reasons they stay.

inbox.title: Their coach, one tap away.
inbox.body: Messages, your notes and check-ins in one inbox — with you, not a bot, on the other side.
